kaikki_vikisozluk.e: خَبِيص • (ḵabīṣ) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Aramaic חַבִיצָא / חָבִיצָא (ḥābiṣā, ḥabiṣā) / ܚܒܺܝܨܳܐ (ḥəbīṣā), same dish, from חָבַצ (ḥābaṣ) / ܚܒܰܨ (ḥbaṣ, “to beat into a pulp, to press, to squeeze”).
g: a dish from flour and fat and dates or honey or the like for sweetening put together and fried for festive breakfast, khabees

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: خَبَصَ • (ḵabaṣa) I (non-past يَخْبِصُ (yaḵbiṣu), verbal noun خَبْص (ḵabṣ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Denominal verb from خَبِيص (ḵabīṣ).
g: to mix, to mingle, to confect

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: خَبَّصَ • (ḵabbaṣa) II (non-past يُخَبِّصُ (yuḵabbiṣu), verbal noun تَخْبِيص (taḵbīṣ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Denominal verb from خَبِيص (ḵabīṣ).
g: to mix up, to jumble, to muddle, to mess up
